note: PRIMARY DELIVERABLE: delta-neutral funding-rate harvest. This is a genuinely robust, market-neutral crypto edge that survives realistic costs out-of-sample (Sharpe 4.8 OOS, max DD <1%, ~65% winning days, worst day -0.5% at 1x). The aggressive 0.25%/day target is only reachable with dangerous (>10x) leverage, so it is NOT met; every other target passes at a sane 3-4x leverage. See RAPPORT_DAYTRADING.md.
data_source: Binance Vision public dumps (funding + perp/spot 8h klines), data/cache/vision_*
mechanics: Per coin, market-neutral: to collect POSITIVE funding hold short-perp + long-spot; to collect NEGATIVE funding hold long-perp + short-spot. Enter only when trailing funding beats the cost hurdle (hysteresis) and hold until it decays -> low turnover. Equal weight across active coins.
